_doc: Per-vehicle calibration and firmware configuration of the ATmega128 flight computer.
Numbers that params.json does not hold live here (and only here); tools/gen_firmware_params.py
turns them into src/params_gen.h. Edit after the bench procedure in firmware/README.md, then re-run
Never type these numbers into a .c/.h file.
imu_fail_kill_s / baro_fail_kill_s are also read by sim/onboard.py (interlock I9): keep the key names.

esc_us._doc: ESC pulse: off (boot, every state except POWERED) and the throttle range u = 0..1 -> min..max

imu_mounting._doc: body axis = sign * IMU (MPU-6050 chip) axis; one of +x,-x,+y,-y,+z,-z each; must form a proper rotation (det = +1)

_doc: LoRa ground-link firmware settings that params.json flight_computer.link does not hold (SPEC 10.3).
aux_wait_max_s: lora_uart - a reply waits at most this long for the module's AUX = ready, then it is sent anyway (counted).
sx127x_spi_hz_max: SPI clock limit through the BSS138 level shifter (10k pull-up rise time); the generator picks the fastest AVR divider below it.
sx127x_pa_boost: true for RFM95/96 and Ra-01/Ra-02 (antenna on the PA_BOOST pin, 2..17 dBm); false = RFO pin (0..15 dBm).
sx127x_tx_timeout_factor / _margin_s: TxDone must arrive within factor x time-on-air(TELEM) + margin, else the radio is forced back to RX (counted).
nonce_seed_adc_conversions: battery-ADC conversions whose LSB noise seeds the LAUNCH nonce at boot (not a security feature).

pad_still._doc: arming gate outside the estimator (reported as 'aligned'): the pad average must have run its full window and the vehicle must have been still this long

_vbat_scale_doc: measured pack voltage / logged pack voltage (divider tolerance); 1.0 until calibrated
